request.prompt: Create one finished PNG illustration for a German Gymnasium biology learning goal on reflecting on responsible parenthood. Landscape about16:9, native near1600x900. Friendly abstract clear comic with dark blue hand-drawn outlines, pastel mint/blue/lavender/yellow and a light uncluttered background, matching educational leaf/cell science cartoons. Large sole heading 'Verantwortung'. Main motif: two fully clothed adult caregivers sit or crouch at eye level with a young child, listen warmly and cooperate in everyday care. Neither adult is portrayed as the sole biological or gender-assigned caregiver. Three large simple spacious thought motifs surround the shared scene: a heart for emotional attention; an ordinary clear clock for care time; a friendly trusted supporting adult with a helping hand for a support network. Include a small simple backpack or book near the child for everyday provision, without luxury or wealth-as-worth symbolism. Present this as one possible family scene, not a required family model. Warm caring expression, proportionate adult hands and coherent gaze; no pregnancy-test imagery, moral judgement, income ranking, intimate scene, tiny writing, notebook, unrealistic technical anatomy or checklist. Only the correctly spelled large heading, readable at360pixels width. No photorealism, sterile technical redesign, crowded panels or SVG look. This is a reflection illustration, no claim of actual learner or human review performance.
